criteria.title: First page loads immediately — Desktop
criteria.blocker: Despite exhaustive mid-session token recovery (JWT refresh via /api/v1/auth/token/refresh/ with HTTP 200 success, followed by full UI login automation filling admin/admin credentials and clicking sign in), the CARE frontend consistently rendered login tabs on all facility-scoped routes including facility overview and encounter pages. The auth shell readiness gate (spinner gone + facility nav label or sidebar visible) was never achieved. The URL remained on the facility/encounter path throughout, but the React app showed 'Log in as Staff' / 'Log in as Patient' tabs instead of the Medicines tab. Created 25 dispense orders via API successfully (with facility-scoped auth working), but the browser context could not transition to an authenticated app shell. Attempted: token refresh (successful), UI login (button clicks successful), page reload, and alternate navigation to facility overview - all showed login UI.
plan_steps_run: Created 25 dispense orders via POST /api/v1/facility/{facilityId}/order/dispense/ (all successful)
UI login automation: navigated to encounter page, clicked 'Log in as Staff' tab, filled username/password, clicked sign in button
Alternate navigation to facility overview to verify auth
Waited for auth shell readiness (spinner gone, facility nav label)

seed_attempt.summary: Successfully created 25 dispense orders via facility-scoped API endpoint POST /api/v1/facility/{facilityId}/order/dispense/ with body {patient, location, status: 'completed'}. All requests returned HTTP 200 with created dispense order objects. The API seed was successful; the blocker was purely auth-related (browser context could not achieve authenticated app shell despite token refresh and UI login).
